findings.summary: validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError if the customers table has duplicate customer_id values, so callers must pass a deduplicated table.
fillna("unknown") raises if region is categorical without an "unknown" category, and customers with null region are also labeled "unknown", which the docstring doesn't mention.
("order_id", "count") skips null order_ids so order counts may be too low ("size" would count rows), and sum skips null amount_cents so those orders add no revenue.
sort_values is not stable by default, so regions with equal revenue may be ordered nondeterministically; kind="stable" is needed for deterministic output.
